{{Top|leg}}
A '''Corporate Complex''' was the name given to a territory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]] in which [[Mining/Legends|mining]] companies were given complete autonomy. In turn, the [[Council of Elders (Saurton)|Council of Elders]] received a large profit. Mining companies bid on the rights to mine the territory for a set number of years, and were granted charters. Within the Corporate Complexes, [[Saurton]] were free to practice their traditions laws and customs in dealing with their fellow Saurton, although they were expected to follow company laws regarding the treatment of members of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
